items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: because Kim Warren, his band, he bought from there.

ctx.x: Yeah, I don't know how they selected this band. That's their business. Yeah. You see? And we were really treated very wonderfully. How was the response to... That's what I said, the response. They had three fans in there. They have a jazz, one city up in the government, and they have a jazz club, which I was very much surprised. In Russia? Because every place I went before that, they have them. Yeah. And I got some recordure they gave us. They copied the big bands back there when they were popular in the 30s, the…
And they play jazz in Russian?
